verdict.rationale: Postman supports unattended automation mainly through external tooling. The Postman CLI and Postman API can run collections inside CI/CD pipelines, the CLI offers webhook handling for event-driven integrations, and the docs say you can build automation into your workflow, including visual API workflows. However, its AI Agent Mode is described as interactive natural-language action, not autonomous background execution, and no native scheduler or background runner is shown. Missing for 10: native scheduled or background runs within Postman, autonomous agent-driven background tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of background automation.
